podcast.title: Idealized Remembrance in Late 70s
podcast.body: An "idealized remembrance" of the 1960s began to take hold by the end of the 1970s and has since become a persistent cultural phenomenon. "This was an idealized remembrance of the 1960s, took hold by the end of the 70s and never really went away."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Reunions: Some Lasted....and Sadly, Some Didn't ｜ Part 3

podcast.title: Influence on Melodic Bass
podcast.body: Matthew Good's musical upbringing and influences included 60s music, which instilled in him an appreciation for the bass as a "very melodic instrument." This understanding of bass informed his approach to songwriting and arrangement in his solo career. "coming from someone who was really raised an influence on 60s and 70s music, the bass to me was always a very melodic instrument."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Matt Good: In His Own Words - Part 2
